selected_script.angle: Trying to clean the sticky, dusty grease layer on top of the fridge with a wet rag just makes a muddy smear; Liapu spray cuts through the gummy layer instantly for an effortless wipe down.
selected_script.hook: I ignored the top of my fridge for months because wet rags just turn that sticky dust into a muddy mess.

script_record.segment_01: I ignored the top of my fridge for months because wet rags just turn that sticky dust into a muddy mess. It’s disgusting.
script_record.segment_02: Then I tried Liapu. You just spray it on this gummy grease and it instantly breaks it down. Look at how easily it wipes away.
script_record.segment_03: Zero sticky residue left behind. Plus it kills 99.9% of bacteria like Salmonella and E. Coli. Grab this for those impossible kitchen jobs.
